top_signals.title: Tech Stocks Drop on Concerns About AI, Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Technology shares fell, snapping this week’s rally, after disappointing megacap earnings revived concerns about the billions of dollars companies are pouring into artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
